recognize_zh: 低倍下骨小樑增厚、不規則且互相吻合（osteosclerosis），骨小樑間幾乎被呈漩渦狀、流線狀排列的梭形纖維組織取代，造血細胞與脂肪都明顯減少；這是纖維期骨髓纖維化的典型低倍樣貌。
features: Thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae with new woven bone formation (osteosclerosis)
Intertrabecular spaces largely replaced by fibrous tissue with streaming, swirling spindle cells
Markedly reduced residual hematopoiesis and near-absent marrow fat
Reduced intertrabecular marrow space, with small marrow islands trapped within bone in the right half
Individual megakaryocyte morphology is not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone marrow trephine shows marked architectural distortion. The bony trabeculae are thickened, irregular, and anastomosing, with areas of new bone formation that encroach on the marrow space. The intertrabecular spaces are largely replaced by fibrous tissue with a streaming spindle-cell pattern, and residual hematopoietic tissue and fat are markedly reduced. Megakaryocyte morphology cannot be assessed at this power, and reticulin/trichrome stains are required to grade fibrosis. Findings are consistent with an advanced fibrotic stage of myelofibrosis with osteosclerosis.

ddx.dx: Secondary myelofibrosis (post-PV/post-ET, metastatic carcinoma, granulomatous disease)
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical at low power; history, JAK2/CALR/MPL status, and a search for carcinoma cells (keratin IHC) or granulomas separate them.
Fibrosis is predominantly peritrabecular with osteoclastic tunneling resorption rather than diffuse intertrabecular fibrosis with atypical megakaryocyte clusters.
Paratrabecular fibrotic aggregates contain spindle mast cells positive for tryptase and CD117 with CD25 aberrancy, often with eosinophils.
Presents acutely with increased CD34+ blasts and dysplastic small megakaryocytes on IHC, not a chronic course with osteosclerosis.
